title: Benedicta es (Piéton)
desc: Loyset Piéton, Benedicta es, 1539. 6 voices (Cantus, Altus, Quinta pars, Tenor, Sexta pars, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Model_0023); edited by Vincent Besson, Richard Freedman. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
